// Each check is one Prometheus query plus the threshold that makes it a finding.
// warnAbove/warnBelow are optional: a check with neither is context, never a finding.
const checks = [
  { name: 'Pods that never scheduled', query: 'count(kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Pods pending or failed', query: 'count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Containers stuck waiting', query: 'count(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Container restarts (24h)', query: 'round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h])) or vector(0))', warnAbove: 5 },
  { name: 'Failed Jobs', query: 'count(kube_job_status_failed > 0) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Deployments missing replicas', query: 'count(kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable > 0) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'DaemonSets unavailable', query: 'count(kube_daemonset_status_number_unavailable > 0) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'PVCs not bound', query: 'count(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{phase!="Bound"} == 1) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Nodes not Ready', query: 'count(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"} == 0) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Nodes under pressure', query: 'count(kube_node_status_condition{condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure",status="true"} == 1) or vector(0)', warnAbove: 0 },
  { name: 'Memory requested of allocatable', query: 'round(100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))', unit: '%', warnAbove: 90 },
  { name: 'Root disk used', query: 'round(100 * max(container_fs_usage_bytes{id="/",device!~"/dev/loop.*"} / container_fs_limit_bytes{id="/",device!~"/dev/loop.*"}))', unit: '%', warnAbove: 85 },
  { name: 'Soonest certificate expiry', query: 'round(min(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds - time()) / 86400)', unit: ' days', warnBelow: 14 },
  { name: 'Players online', query: 'round(sum(game_server_players) or vector(0))' },
];

return checks.map((check) => ({ json: check }));
